about_short_description.short_description: Andi is an innovative solution which is responding to a data-driven world facing new challenges for managing and using data.

product.name: Andi
product.description: A data access and analysis tool that enables users to extract, access, and analyze data without writing complex SQL queries.

product.name: Andi Queue Explorer
product.description: A feature for fast browsing and analysis of message queues like Websphere MQ and ActiveMQ Artemis, with automation capabilities via integrated scripting.

product.name: Andi Integrated Scripting
product.description: A scripting framework within Andi that automates data access, analysis, and manipulation tasks across databases and file types.

product.name: Andi XML Viewer
product.description: A tool within Andi that formats, highlights, and enables searching of XML data for easier analysis and editing.
